description_en: Queries the list of resources connected to WAF in cloud native mode
description_zh: 查询云产品接入资源列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-cloud-resource-list --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudResourceList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the resource ownership user
parameters.name: owner_user_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the resource
parameters.name: resource_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The port of the cloud service connected to WAF
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The cloud service to which the resource belongs. Valid values:

alb: Application Load Balancer (ALB).

mse: Microservices Engine (MSE).

fc: Function Compute (FC).

sae: Serverless App Engine (SAE).

ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS).
clb4: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) (TCP).
clb7: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) (HTTP/HTTPS).
apig: API Gateway (APIG).
nlb: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
ddos: Anti-DDoS.

Different products are supported in different regions. If you specify a value for this parameter, make sure that the product is supported in the specified region. Otherwise, the query may fail
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属云产品，取值：

alb：表示ALB产品。

mse：表示MSE产品。

fc：表示FC产品。

sae：表示SAE产品。

ecs：表示ECS产品。
clb4：表示CLB(TCP)产品。
clb7：表示CLB(HTTP/HTTPS)产品。
apig：表示APIG产品。
nlb：表示NLB产品。
ddos：表示DDoS产品。

每个产品支持的地域不同，产品筛选字段有值时，需要参考地域支持的产品，否则可能导致筛选失败
parameters.name: resource_product

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF in cloud native mode.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html to connect a resource and then view the resource ID in the response
parameters.help_zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID
parameters.name: cloud_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token for the next page. If a value is returned for this parameter, the next page exists.
If this parameter has a return value, the next page exists. You can use the returned NextToken value as a request parameter to obtain the next page of data. Repeat this process until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
下一页查询凭证（Token），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。
该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name connected to WAF.
This parameter is supported only when the cloud service type is ddos
parameters.help_zh:
接入 WAF 的域名。
仅当云产品类型为ddos时，支持查询
parameters.name: resource_domain
